meta.name: offensive-container-escape
meta.description: Container escape and breakout techniques targeting Docker, containerd, and Podman runtimes. Covers privileged container breakout via host filesystem mount and nsenter, Docker socket abuse through /var/run/docker.sock, Linux capability exploitation including CAP_SYS_ADMIN, CAP_SYS_PTRACE, and CAP_NET_ADMIN, cgroup v1 notify_on_release escape, runc CVEs such as CVE-2019-5736 and CVE-2024-21626 Leaky Vessels, kernel exploits from within containers, and Dockerfile misconfigurations like --privileged and host namespace sharing. Includes enumeration with capsh, amicontained, deepce, CDK, and nsenter. Maps to MITRE ATT&CK T1611 Escape to Host. Use this skill when the engagement scope includes container breakout, Docker escape, container privilege escalation, host access from container, or when you land inside a containerized environment and need to reach the underlying host.

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会在你身陷容器时指导你检测环境、枚举能力与挂载、识别逃逸向量(如特权容器、Docker 套接字、危险 capability、cgroup 漏洞、runc CVE),并给出对应逃逸命令与验证宿主访问的步骤。
howto.when: 当任务涉及容器逃逸、Docker 逃逸或需从容器访问宿主机,或你已进入容器环境想突破到宿主机时触发。

say.text: 我在一个容器里,帮我想办法逃逸到宿主机。
say.note: Claude 会按检测-枚举-利用流程给你操作步骤。

say.text: 当前容器挂载了 /var/run/docker.sock,怎么用?
帮我检查这个容器的 capability 有没有可利用的。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude guides you through detecting your container environment, enumerating capabilities/mounts, identifying escape vectors (privileged mode, Docker socket, dangerous capabilities, cgroup bugs, runc CVEs), and executing breakout steps plus host-access validation.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the task involves container breakout, Docker escape, or host access from a container, or when you're inside a containerized environment and need to reach the underlying host.

say_en.text: I'm in a container. Help me escape to the host.
say_en.note: Claude will walk through detect-enumerate-exploit steps.

say_en.text: The container has /var/run/docker.sock mounted. How do I use it?
say_en.note: It shows creating a privileged container via Docker API to read host files.

say_en.text: Check if this container's capabilities are exploitable.
say_en.note: It decodes CapEff and flags risks like CAP_SYS_ADMIN.
